payload.title: Embedder support for @kanbus/ui: flat theme, scoped tokens, read-only, narrow layout, publish channel
payload.description: Requested 2026-10-19 by the Chatticus session (Ryan wants one Kanbus-owned board embedded in Chatticus via IssueCollection). Do after AnthusAI/Kanbus#494 (editorial themes) merges, inside its themes system. 1) Scope design tokens: tokens.css sets variables on :root and html.dark, which restyles a host page; scope them under the theme/board root. 2) A flat theme: no borders, outlines, dividers or accent bars (the border-left accent in kanban.css and the selected-card outline break it); selection shown by a background shade; keyboard focus ring kept for accessibility. 3) An explicit readOnly prop on IssueCollection (today read-only only means no onSelectIssue). 4) A narrow panel-width layout mode for side panels. 5) A real publish channel: npm under @kanbus, or at minimum stable versioned release tarballs (today: GitHub release asset per ui-v tag). Spec each in packages/ui/features first; keep the console and Papyrus newsroom boards unchanged.
